Title: @smoke Verify page heading hierarchy follows semantic structure
Steps: 1. Open application home page; 2. Inspect all heading elements (h1, h2, h3, etc.); 3. Verify h1 is the main page title; 4. Verify heading order is sequential without skipping levels; 5. Verify all headings have descriptive text
Expected_Result: Page has exactly one H1 heading; heading hierarchy is sequential without skipping levels

Title: @smoke Verify all form inputs have associated labels
Steps: 1. Locate all form input fields; 2. Inspect each input element; 3. Verify each input has a label element or aria-label attribute; 4. Verify label text is descriptive; 5. Verify label 'for' attribute matches input 'id'
Expected_Result: All form inputs have associated labels with descriptive text and proper id/for attribute mapping

Title: @smoke Verify keyboard navigation is possible without mouse
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Press Tab key repeatedly; 3. Verify all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) are reachable; 4. Verify focus indicator is visible on each focused element; 5. Verify focus order follows logical reading order
Expected_Result: All interactive elements are reachable via keyboard Tab navigation in logical order with visible focus indicators

Title: Verify all images have descriptive alt text
Preconditions: User navigates to product details page
Steps: 1. Load product details page with product images; 2. Inspect all img elements; 3. Verify each img has an alt attribute; 4. Verify alt text is descriptive and not empty; 5. Verify decorative images have empty alt text (alt=''); 6. Verify alt text conveys the same information as the image
Expected_Result: All images have appropriate alt text; decorative images have empty alt; meaningful content in alt text

Title: Verify color is not the only method to convey information
Steps: 1. Navigate to checkout page; 2. Identify any elements where color conveys meaning (e.g., red for error, green for success); 3. Verify those elements also use icons, patterns, or text labels; 4. Verify error messages include descriptive text in addition to color highlighting; 5. Verify success indicators include text or icons
Expected_Result: Information conveyed by color is also conveyed through text
Type: or patterns; color alone is never the only indicator

Title: Verify links have descriptive text and are distinguishable from text
Steps: 1. Locate all links on home page; 2. Verify each link has descriptive text (not generic 'click here'); 3. Verify links are visually distinguishable (underline, color, icon); 4. Verify links have an ARIA role='link' or proper semantic link element; 5. Verify link text indicates the destination or action
Expected_Result: All links have descriptive text and are visually distinguishable; no generic link text like 'click here'

Title: Verify buttons have clear labels and proper ARIA roles
Steps: 1. Locate all buttons on cart page; 2. Verify each button has visible text label or aria-label; 3. Verify button type attribute is set correctly (submit, reset, button); 4. Verify buttons are distinguishable from links; 5. Verify button purpose is clear from label or ARIA description
Expected_Result: All buttons have clear labels or ARIA labels; button purpose is evident; proper semantic button elements used

Title: Verify form validation errors are announced and marked up correctly
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Leave email field empty; 3. Click submit; 4. Verify error message appears; 5. Verify error has role='alert' or aria-live='polite'; 6. Verify error is associated with the input via aria-describedby; 7. Verify invalid input has aria-invalid='true'
Expected_Result: Validation errors are announced to screen readers; errors have proper ARIA attributes; inputs marked as invalid

Title: Verify contrast ratio meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for text)
Steps: 1. Capture screenshot of page with all text; 2. Use accessibility tool to measure color contrast; 3. Verify heading text has contrast ratio >= 4.5:1; 4. Verify body text has contrast ratio >= 4.5:1; 5. Verify UI components have contrast ratio >= 3:1
Expected_Result: All text and UI components meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 for text; 3:1 for UI components)

Title: Verify font size is readable and resizable
Steps: 1. Navigate to home page; 2. Verify body text font size is at least 14px; 3. Verify text remains readable when page zoom is increased to 200%; 4. Verify user can zoom page in browser without horizontal scrolling becoming necessary (or minimal); 5. Verify all text remains visible and readable after zoom
Expected_Result: Body text is at least 14px; page remains readable at 200% zoom; no unnecessary horizontal scrolling after zoom

Title: Verify page structure uses semantic HTML (header nav main footer)
Steps: 1. Load home page; 2. Inspect page structure in DevTools; 3. Verify page uses <header> for header content; 4. Verify page uses <nav> for navigation; 5. Verify page uses <main> for main content; 6. Verify page uses <footer> for footer content; 7. Verify no presentation-only divs are used for structure
Expected_Result: Page uses semantic HTML elements (header nav main footer); structure is meaningful and logical

Title: Verify form inputs can be populated and submitted using keyboard only
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page; 2. Use Tab to focus email input; 3. Type valid email; 4. Tab to password input; 5. Type password; 6. Tab to submit button; 7. Press Enter to submit; 8. Verify form submits successfully; 9. Verify no mouse interaction required
Expected_Result: Form can be completely filled and submitted using keyboard alone; no mouse interaction required

Title: Verify skip navigation link is available and functional
Steps: 1. Load home page without interacting; 2. Press Tab key to reveal first keyboard-focused element; 3. Verify 'Skip to main content' or similar link appears; 4. Press Enter on skip link; 5. Verify focus moves to main content area; 6. Verify link is visible on focus or screen reader can detect it
Expected_Result: Skip navigation link exists and is keyboard accessible; link moves focus to main content when activated

Title: Verify focus is managed when modals or overlays open
Preconditions: User clicks to open cart sidebar
Steps: 1. Load home page; 2. Click to open modal/overlay (e.g., shopping cart sidebar); 3. Verify focus is trapped within modal; 4. Verify Tab navigation cycles through modal controls only; 5. Verify pressing Tab after last element wraps to first modal element; 6. Verify Escape key closes modal; 7. Verify focus returns to trigger element when modal closes
Expected_Result: Focus is trapped and managed in modal; Tab cycles within modal; Escape closes modal; focus restoration works

Title: Verify data tables have proper header associations
Steps: 1. Navigate to page with a data table; 2. Inspect table markup; 3. Verify table uses <th> for header cells; 4. Verify header cells have scope attribute (row/col/rowgroup/colgroup); 5. Verify data cells are properly associated with headers; 6. Verify table has summary or caption
Expected_Result: Table headers are properly marked; headers have scope attributes; data cells associated with headers; table has caption

Title: Verify page language is declared
Steps: 1. Load page; 2. Inspect <html> element; 3. Verify lang attribute is present; 4. Verify lang value is valid (e.g., lang='en' for English); 5. Verify lang matches page content language
Expected_Result: HTML element has lang attribute set to correct language code

Title: Verify page has descriptive title that conveys purpose
Preconditions: User navigates to each major page
Steps: 1. Navigate to home page; 2. Check page <title>; 3. Verify title is unique and describes page content; 4. Navigate to login page; 5. Verify login page has distinct title; 6. Navigate to product page; 7. Verify product page title is descriptive
Expected_Result: Each page has unique descriptive title; title conveys page purpose to screen reader users

Title: Verify interactive elements have sufficient click/touch target size
Steps: 1. Load page; 2. Inspect all clickable elements (buttons, links, form inputs); 3. Verify minimum touch target size is 44x44 CSS pixels for mobile; 4. Verify minimum click target size is 24x24 pixels for desktop; 5. Verify spacing between targets is adequate to prevent accidental clicks
Expected_Result: All interactive elements meet minimum size requirements (44x44 for mobile; 24x24 for desktop) with adequate spacing

Title: Verify focus indicators are visible and clear
Preconditions: User presses Tab to navigate page
Steps: 1. Navigate to any page; 2. Press Tab repeatedly; 3. Verify focused element has visible indicator (outline or highlight); 4. Verify focus indicator has sufficient contrast; 5. Verify focus indicator clearly identifies the focused element; 6. Verify focus indicator is not removed via CSS outline:none
Expected_Result: All interactive elements show clear visible focus indicators with adequate contrast; no outline:none in CSS

Title: Verify dynamic content updates are announced to screen readers
Preconditions: User performs action that updates page content
Steps: 1. Navigate to page with dynamic content (e.g., add item to cart); 2. Perform action that updates DOM; 3. Verify update region has aria-live attribute; 4. Verify aria-live value is appropriate (polite/assertive); 5. Verify screen reader announces the change; 6. Verify announcement is timely and accurate
Expected_Result: Dynamic content updates are announced via aria-live regions; announcements are polite and timely
